# ScrollFrame

- Inherits [`UIObject`](uiobject.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("ScrollFrame")`

A `Frame` whose contents can be larger than it is, and that scrolls to show them. It always clips its descendants, whatever `ClipsDescendants` is set to.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AbsoluteCanvasSize` | `Vector2` | — | read-only | The size of the canvas after layout, in pixels. It is never smaller than the frame, and it includes the effect of `AutomaticCanvasSize`. |
| `AbsoluteWindowSize` | `Vector2` | — | read-only | The size of the visible part of the canvas after layout, in pixels, which is the frame's own size. `AbsoluteCanvasSize - AbsoluteWindowSize` is how far the frame can scroll. |
| `AutomaticCanvasSize` | `Enum.AutomaticSize` | `Enum.AutomaticSize.None` | read/write | The axes on which the canvas grows to hold its contents. The contents are measured as the extent of a `UIListLayout` or `UIGridLayout`, or else as the farthest point any child reaches, plus the frame's `UIPadding`. On those axes the canvas is the larger of `CanvasSize` and the contents, so a list that a script adds rows to scrolls without the script measuring it. |
| `CanvasPosition` | `Vector2` | `Vector2.zero` | read/write | How far the canvas is scrolled, in pixels. At the next layout it is clamped to the range the canvas allows. |
| `CanvasSize` | `UDim2` | `UDim2.new()` | read/write | The size of the scrollable area. Children are laid out against this size instead of the frame's own size. |
| `ElasticBehavior` | `Enum.ElasticBehavior` | `Enum.ElasticBehavior.WhenScrollable` | read/write | Whether the content stretches when dragged beyond the end and springs back on release, and whether a fling that reaches the end bounces. The stretch is only drawn: `CanvasPosition` never leaves the range of the canvas. |
| `ScrollBarImageColor` | `Color3` | `Color3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)` | read/write | The color of the scroll bar. The thumb is drawn in this color, and the track under it in the same color at a quarter of the opacity. |
| `ScrollBarImageTransparency` | `number` | `0` | read/write | How transparent the scroll bar is, from 0 (opaque) to 1 (invisible; the frame still scrolls). It is separate from `BackgroundTransparency`. |
| `ScrollBarThickness` | `number` | `12` | read/write | The thickness of the scroll bar, in pixels. At 0 no bar is drawn and the frame still scrolls, which suits a touch screen.<br><br>A bar appears only on an axis that can scroll. The length of the thumb shows how much of the canvas is visible, and it is never shorter than the bar is thick. The thumb can be dragged. |
| `ScrollingDirection` | `Enum.ScrollingDirection` | `Enum.ScrollingDirection.XY` | read/write | The axes along which the player can scroll. When a scroll frame is inside another, a drag goes to the one that scrolls in the direction the drag started, and stays with it until the pointer is released. A vertical list inside a horizontal carousel scrolls on a vertical drag and leaves a horizontal drag to the carousel. |
| `ScrollingEnabled` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether the player can scroll the frame, with the wheel, a drag, a fling, the bar or by moving the selection out of view. A script can still scroll it by setting `CanvasPosition`. |
